title: The Life-Changing Magic Of Tidying Up

questions.q: What single question guides Marie Kondo's tidying process?
questions.why: The book states the core question is "Does this spark joy?"

questions.q: How long does Kondo estimate it takes to tidy a client's house?
questions.why: The text notes she takes around six hours on average

questions.q: Which category should you tackle first according to the book?
questions.why: The book advises starting with easier categories

questions.q: What is the main benefit of treating tidying as a special event?
questions.why: The text says a special event turns it into fun and life-changing

questions.q: Which question is NOT listed as a simple question to decide what to keep?
a: Has it fulfilled its purpose already?
What is the purpose of this object?
Why did I get this thing?
questions.why: The book lists purpose, fulfillment, reason, time, origin, not warranty
